findings.statement: Qualified q_o plus its exact rank-local successor contract and Bellman rank recursion already provide one exact standard-7x6 Q,D realization; the open problem is minimality/simplification rather than existence.

The bottom-up recursive quotient classes used by the cocycle campaign are future-derived and therefore are not admissible final definitions of Q under the new rank-local objective. They remain compression oracles.

On the complete 4x4 physical carrier, remaining-move pruning, support-release/turn pruning, and the nonterminal frontier blocker each yield strict rank-local compressions of q_o that remain exact literal transition congruences.

On the same complete 4x4 carrier, final-cap pruning and the combined tested closure representation preserve exact scalar value and literal action values but fail full future-transition congruence. Thus Q-V/Q-A can be strictly coarser than the tested Q-F representation.

Support alone, residuals-plus-rank without support, residual counts, residual-size histograms, per-cell incidence summaries, incidence+histogram, XOR/OR summaries, and ownership-erased exact residual unions all have exact 4x4 counterexamples even for scalar value sufficiency.

The full S4 column orbit of q_o is a strict rank-local 4x4 compression (34,094 to 10,496 classes) preserving transporter-aware transition congruence, transported action values, and scalar value; literal action labels are intentionally not preserved without the transporter.

A direct exhaustive algebra audit independently verifies T(pi q, pi c)=pi T(q,c) for every complete-4x4 q_o state, every column permutation and every action, with 7,309,776 transition-equivariance checks and zero mismatches.

Full column permutation need not be a physical board symmetry to be an automorphism of the compiled q_o transition algebra. Physical geometry and compiled residual-transition symmetry are different layers.
